result.gate: literal primary-source scope and endpoint mathematics only
result.strongest_verified_claim: There exists u in A^(1/2) for homogeneous-Dirichlet Poisson on the unit square, with f=-Delta u in H^-1 outside L2, whose best P0 global H^-1 approximation error is not O(N^-1/2) in the fixed compatible NVB family. Conforming error at N=4^n is at least (c*n-2/sqrt(3))*2^-n; allowing nonconforming NVB descendants does not restore the rate by linear-cost completion.
